contentGapNotes: The article lacks quantitative data: no conversion rate changes, no traffic metrics, no engagement data are mentioned. Consider noting whether these changes correlate with any known business outcomes (though do not claim causation).
No discussion of how the shift affects mobile or viewport-specific CRO decisions — Crisp's navigation and headline may render differently on mobile, which could affect intent matching.

Missing analysis of competitor positioning: does the shift from 'startup tool' to 'AI platform' mirror broader category movement, or is Crisp unique? Competitive context would strengthen the 'lessons for SaaS teams' section.

No mention of pricing page alignment: did Crisp's pricing page shift to match the AI-first positioning? Homepage-to-pricing consistency is a conversion factor.
The article assumes readers can access the live 2026 Crisp homepage to 'open in incognito and count CTAs' — but provides no archived screenshots or wayback links for verification.
